description: Address all four PR #206 review findings on tests/Trackdub.Sdk.Tests/PipelineWizardStateTests.cs (and one small production accessor + one task-record reconciliation). (1) Make the reset-flow test set EVERY wizard property to a non-default value before reset and assert EVERY field after reset. (2) On the second Configure attempt, queue a valid language 'es' so the wizard actually re-enters, and assert the picker overlay is active after re-entry. (3) Replace the hardcoded-string reflection accessor GetWizardState with a compile-checked internal accessor on PipelineTuiScreen (and use the observable HasOverlay signal to assert re-entry). (4) Reconcile .agents/tasks/task-encapsulate-pipeline-wizard-state/features/FEAT-003.json so its status and verification evidence match what is actually run in this environment. These are tightly coupled (all touch the same test file), so they are ONE feature.
steps: FINDING #3 (compile-checked accessor) — Add an internal accessor for the wizard state on the production screen src/Trackdub.Cli/Tui/Screens/PipelineTuiScreen.cs. Add an internal read-only property, e.g. `internal PipelineWizardState WizardState => _wizard;`, placed near the private `_wizard` field. Trackdub.Cli.csproj already has <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Trackdub.Sdk.Tests"/>, so this is visible to the test assembly. Do NOT change the private field name or reset semantics.

FINDING #3 (remove reflection) — In tests/Trackdub.Sdk.Tests/PipelineWizardStateTests.cs, delete the private static `GetWizardState(PipelineTuiScreen screen)` helper that uses typeof(...).GetField("_wizard", BindingFlags...). Replace ALL its call sites with the new compile-checked accessor `screen.WizardState`. Remove the now-unused `using System.Reflection;` import. This makes a production field rename fail at build time, not runtime.

FINDING #1 (exhaustive reset coverage) — Rewrite the body of `ConfigureFlow_ResetReplacesWizardStateWithDefaults` so the first wizard walk drives EVERY one of the 12 PipelineWizardState properties to a NON-DEFAULT value, then asserts EVERY property returns to its default after reset. Use this exact picker navigation (each picker starts at SelectedIndex 0; DownArrow=MoveDown, Enter=select). After OpenConfigureWizardAsync (which queues 'es' as target language via the TextPrompt): VoiceClone picker [No,Yes,Back] -> Down,Enter (Yes => VoiceClone=true). ExportFormat picker [auto,mp4,mkv,Back] -> Down,Down,Enter (mkv). SubtitleFormat picker [srt,vtt,ass,none,skip,Back] -> Down,Enter (vtt => SubtitleFormats=["vtt"]). SubtitleSource picker [translated,transcript,bilingual,Back] -> Down,Down,Enter (bilingual => SubtitleSource="bilingual"). Advanced picker [Run,Timbre,Pan,Loudness,ASR,BurnIn,ForceRerun,Video,Back]; each toggle selection re-opens Advanced with index reset to 0, so select each toggle from the top: Timbre = Down,Enter (TimbrePolish=>false); Pan = Down,Down,Enter (RestorePan=>true); Loudness = Down,Down,Down,Enter (MatchLoudness=>true); ASR = Down x4,Enter (AsrRefinement=>true); BurnIn = Down x5,Enter (BurnIn=>true); ForceRerun = Down x6,Enter (ForceRerun=>true). Then Video encoder: from Advanced select Video = Down x7,Enter which opens Video picker [auto,nvenc,qsv,amf,software,videotoolbox,vaapi,Back]; nvenc = Down,Enter (VideoEncoder=>"nvenc"; returns to Advanced). TargetLanguageOverride is set to 'es' by the language prompt at wizard start.

FINDING #1 (assert before reset) — After the first walk, capture `PipelineWizardState beforeReset = screen.WizardState;` and assert ALL 12 fields at their non-default values: VoiceClone true, TimbrePolish false, RestorePan true, MatchLoudness true, AsrRefinement true, BurnIn true, ForceRerun true, ExportFormat "mkv", SubtitleSource "bilingual", SubtitleFormats ["vtt"], VideoEncoder "nvenc", TargetLanguageOverride "es". (Use Assert.Equal for the collection: Assert.Equal(new[]{"vtt"}, beforeReset.SubtitleFormats).)

FINDING #2 (assert picker active) — After the second OpenConfigureWizardAsync, assert the wizard overlay is active using the observable signal: `Assert.True(screen.HasOverlay);` (HasOverlay is public and returns _picker is not null). Then capture `PipelineWizardState afterReset = screen.WizardState;` and assert EVERY field is back to default: VoiceClone false, TimbrePolish true, RestorePan false, MatchLoudness false, AsrRefinement false, BurnIn false, ForceRerun false, ExportFormat null, SubtitleSource null, SubtitleFormats null, VideoEncoder null, and TargetLanguageOverride equals 'es' if the second language prompt set it (or null if not prompted — assert whichever the flow actually produces; do NOT leave TargetLanguageOverride unasserted). Every one of the 12 fields must be asserted after reset.

Update the other tests in the file (SelectSubtitleFormatAsync and any helper) to use screen.WizardState instead of the deleted GetWizardState helper. Keep the two sentinel assertions (none => empty list, skip => null) intact.

FINDING #4 (reconcile task record) — Edit .agents/tasks/task-encapsulate-pipeline-wizard-state/features/FEAT-003.json. After you have actually run the build + tests + format in THIS environment, update the `findings` field to record the REAL results you observed (SDK 10.0.401 selected via global.json latestFeature; restore succeeded under OPEN_INTERNET; the PipelineWizardStateTests build with -warnaserror and pass; dotnet format verify-no-changes clean). Set `status` to "completed" ONLY if those commands genuinely pass; otherwise set it to "blocked" or "in_progress" with an accurate blocked_reason. Remove the stale claim that the tests could not be rerun due to NETSDK1004/Tokenizers restore failure. Do not fabricate results — record exactly what the commands print.
Run dotnet format Trackdub.slnx --verify-no-changes and fix any formatting the tool flags in the edited files.
acceptance_criteria: PipelineTuiScreen exposes an internal accessor (e.g. WizardState) returning the current PipelineWizardState; the test file no longer contains any GetField("_wizard") reflection or `using System.Reflection;`.

ConfigureFlow_ResetReplacesWizardStateWithDefaults sets all 12 wizard properties to non-default values, asserts all 12 before reset, and asserts all 12 after reset (including RestorePan and every other previously-unasserted field).

The second Configure attempt queues a valid 'es' language (not empty) and the test asserts screen.HasOverlay is true after re-entry, proving the wizard re-activated (previously it silently returned before BeginVoiceClonePickerAsync).
dotnet build tests/Trackdub.Sdk.Tests --configuration Release -m:1 -warnaserror succeeds with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
dotnet test tests/Trackdub.Sdk.Tests --configuration Release --no-build -m:1 --filter "FullyQualifiedName~PipelineWizardStateTests" passes all tests.
dotnet format Trackdub.slnx --verify-no-changes reports no changes.
FEAT-003.json status and findings reflect the actual verification run in this environment (no stale restore-failure claim); status is 'completed' only if build+test+format genuinely pass.
findings:
All four PR #206 review findings addressed. (#3) Added `internal PipelineWizardState WizardState => _wizard;` to PipelineTuiScreen.cs and removed the reflection-based GetWizardState helper plus the `using System.Reflection;` import from PipelineWizardStateTests.cs; all call sites now use screen.WizardState (compile-checked). (#1) ConfigureFlow_ResetReplacesWizardStateWithDefaults now drives all 12 wizard properties to non-default values (the documented DownArrow/Enter counts were exactly correct — no off-by-one adjustment needed), asserts all 12 before reset, and asserts all 12 after reset. (#2) Second Configure re-entry now queues `console.Input.PushTextWithEnter("es")` instead of an empty string, so the wizard proceeds past the target-language guard; the test asserts Assert.True(screen.HasOverlay) proving re-activation. After reset TargetLanguageOverride is 'es' because the second entry re-prompts (snapshot target language is null in this offline test setup). (#4) Reconciled task-encapsulate-pipeline-wizard-state/features/FEAT-003.json findings to record the real verification (removed the stale NETSDK1004/Tokenizers restore-failure claim); status left 'completed' since it now genuinely passes.
